manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Collect the rounded oval bread and the rectangular bread loaf inside the beige breadbasket.

Task description: Put the rounded oval bread on the left and rectangular bread on the right into the beige bread basket at the front center.

Success criteria: Both pieces of bread are near the center of the beige basket, placed inside and above the table; both grippers are open and have released them.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the fuller sides around the middle of the oval bread’s long axis, with the gripper closing across its short axis. Avoid the narrowed ends as much as possible to reduce slipping.
- For rectangular bread, grip middle sections of opposite flat sides, opening slightly wider than local width. Confirm the fingers straddle it before closing rather than pressing its top or gripping only corners.
- When passing over the basket rim, keep the bread bottom and fingertips above the rim with enough clearance to avoid catching it and dropping the bread or shifting the basket.
- Before releasing, ensure the bread is supported inside the basket and leave room for the fingers to open. If another piece is already inside, watch that the fingertips do not push it toward the edge.
